programme.desc: From a visiting alien ship, a fibrous, web-like creature secures itself inside an Enterprise launch bay and ensnares several crewmen. Hoshi must work to learn the creature's bizarre language in order to save the trapped crewmen.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Archer must delay the crew's much-needed shore leave to transport a Vulcan Ambassador from her planet of Mazar to rendezvous with a Vulcan ship.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Archer and Trip aid a disabled vessel and, in gratitude for their assistance, the vessel's captain invites the two officers to dinner in his desert-landscape village on his nearby home planet.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Finally arriving at the paradise of planet Risa, the Enterprise crew is able to enjoy two days and nights of much needed shore leave.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: The temporal cold war heats us as Captain Archer is taken to the 31st century by the Sulibans.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: As Archer makes his way back from the 31st century to prevent the Sulibans destroying the Enterprise, his crew tries to fend off the violent machinations and interrogations of leader Silik and come up with their own plan to keep the ship safe.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: T'Pol relates a tale of the Vulcans real First Contact when she claims that a relative of hers crash-landed in Carbon Creek, Pennsylvania in 1957, mingled with the townsfolk, and rescued workers in a mining accident.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: When Enterprise is struck by a soon-to-detonate weapon and lodges in the ship's hull, Reed must deactivate it, but his subsequent injury and a group of encroaching Romulans bent on destruction force Archer think creatively to save the crew and ship.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: To facilitate a lengthy list of necessary repairs, the crew visits an alien station with a super-computer that can fix anything. But the automated station's demands for payment seem too good to be true...until Mayweather is discovered dead.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Archer spends a sleepless night tending to his quarantined beagle Porthos and figuring out how to apologize to the quirky, ritualistic Kreetassens he inadvertently offended on a recent visit.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Archer feels compelled to help a rustic alien colony that finds their rich resources constantly dwindling due to the Klingons' pillaging ways.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Assigned to track down a Vulcan fugitive she lost 17 years ago, T'Pol enlists Archer and Mayweather's help in retrieving him, but finding the criminal triggers mysterious, deadly memories she has trouble resolving.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: When Reed accidentally loses his communicator during a visit to a pre-Warp culture, he and Archer must retrieve it, but when they do, they are mistaken for spies and are faced with the threat of execution.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: When the Federation promotes an officer exchange program, Commander Riker decides to accept an assignment aboard a Klingon war ship.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: The Enterprise is ordered to proceed to an emergency Rendez-Vous to collect a special envoy who is traveling from Starbase 153 to meet them.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Riker returns from an away team mission wounded and infected with microbes from the planet below. He is soon in a coma in sick bay, the microbes having fused itself to his sciatic nerve and impeding his normal functions.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: A Klingon commander boards the Enterprise in an officer exchange program initiated by Starfleet, much to the chagrin of the crew.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: When the head of the Klingon high council passes on, Picard finds himself in the middle of the struggle for the now-vacant position. Meanwhile, Worf re-unites with a past love, only to find he now has a son.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: A retired admiral boards the Enterprise in an effort to determine the actions aboard the ship surrounding an act of sabotage and possible treason.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Both Capt. Picard and Lt. Worf must decide where their priorities lie as the Klingon Empire descends into civil war.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Picard risks all-out war with the Romulans when he involves Starfleet in a Klingon civil war.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Worf learns some painful lessons about parenting when his son Alexander arrives to join his father on the Enterprise.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Loyalty and ethics clash when a paralyzed Worf asks to help him commit suicide.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: An emergency beam out renders four crewmen down to childhood shortly before renegade Ferengi take over the Enterprise and offload the adults.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: A Holodeck fantasy goes awry, sending Worf and his son into a Wild West showdown with a villain who's a dead ringer for Data.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Geordi is enamored with a beautiful and mysterious Starfleet lieutenant accused of murder.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Worf and Data embark on unusual journeys to seek out their fathers.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: In seeking his father, Worf discovers a prisoner-of-war camp that has evolved into a Klingon/Romulan haven - an Eden where Worf becomes their serpent.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Picard finds himself in a race with Cardassians, Klingons, and Romulans to solve a four billion-year-old genetic puzzle.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: A pioneering Ferengi scientist Is found dead, and Beverly risks her career to prove he was murdered.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Worf finds his faith sorely tested when it appears that the greatest Klingon warrior of all time has returned from the dead to reclaim the empire.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Data's first bad dream turns into a real-life nightmare for the rest of the Enterprise crew.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: The new Starship Enterprise and its crew set out “to boldly go where no one has gone before." Their first mission is to explore the mystery surrounding the creation of the Farpoint station located on planet Deneb IV.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: At the trial, "Q" continues to denounce humans, while Picard defends his race and convinces "Q" that the upcoming mission at Farpoint will be the perfect opportunity to prove his point.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: After diverting to a secret meeting with an old friend and some of Starfleet's finest commanders, Picard finds the Horatio blown to bits just hours after the meeting and he returns the Enterprise to Earth looking for answers.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: With Picard away for routine surgery, the Enterprise responds to an apparent distress call from a Pakled vessel.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Responding to a distress call on one of the Federation's outer-most colonies, the Enterprise arrives...only to find a big hole in the ground where the town used to be, and discovers the Borg are behind the attack.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Commander Riker had no choice as acting captain but fire full force on the Borg starship, despite Picard being on board of it, altered to a Borg calling himself Locutus, both ships are damaged.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: After defeating the Borg, the crew of the Enterprise experiences shore leave in various ways. Captain Picard's return to his family's vineyard in France has some extraordinary repercussions following his time spent as a member of the Borg collective.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: A retired admiral boards the Enterprise in an effort to determine the actions aboard the ship surrounding an act of sabotage and possible treason.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: The crew is rendered helpless when Picard is kidnapped and forced to go to war with an alien captain.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Picard and the crew suffer from conflicting emotions when the Enterprise rescues a critically-injured Borg.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: After a mysterious accident, Picard wakes up living the life of another person on a faraway planet.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: After resigning his command to participate in a dangerous secret mission, Captain Picard is taken hostage by the Cardassians.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: While under the command of an unfeeling new captain, the Enterprise attempts to rescue Picard from the Cardassians.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: After Picard loses his life in a surprise attack, Q gives him the chance to change his destiny.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: While the Enterprise is bombarded with lethal rays, Picard is trapped on board with a band of interstellar thieves.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Picard finds himself travelling between the past, present, and future while attempting to prevent the destruction of humanity... by his own actions.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene prøver å holde seg rolige mens de ser partnerne deres invitere de single på dater men følelsene og sjalusien når nye høyder.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: De single prøver å vise seg fra sin beste side for å konkurrere om parenes oppmerksomhet. Et par begynner å lære hvor vanskelig det er å motstå fristelser.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En overraskelseseliminering vender opp ned på ting i husene. Parene dykker dypere inn i opplevelsen. Noen partnere opplever at de beveger seg lenger unna hverandre.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En ny twist får ting til å skje i begge villaene. Great og Nafeesah tar forholdet sitt til neste nivå. Hall kommer til en livsendrende konklusjon. Marisela gjenoppdager seg selv da skyldfølelsen begynner å sette inn for Paris.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Fristelseslyset er en konstant påminnelse om at det ikke er noen hemmeligheter på øya og alle handlinger har konsekvenser.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Det er på tide med videomeldinger og Mark avslører en annen sjokkerende vri. De single får også lov til å sende videomeldinger. Hvem mottar en melding?

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene håndterer ettervirkningene av videomeldinger i begge villaene. Nye relasjoner blir sterkere og mer intime. Andre begynner å slite med skyldfølelse og usikkerhet da slutten av oppholdet nærmer seg.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene drar på romantiske overnattingsdater med de beste single. Ny romantikk blomstrer, kjærlighetserklæringer og fremtidsplaner lages, og mer enn én person lar seg friste.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene Marisela & Christopher og Vanessa & Roberto gjenforenes for deres eksplosive siste bål. Var forholdet deres sterkt nok til å seire på Temptation Island?

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Kaitlin & Hall og Paris & Great gjenforenes til sine siste bålseremonier. Bål har en egen evne til å avdekke sannheten – selv om denne sannheten har vært en løgn.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene og de single vender tilbake til en dramatisk gjenforening på 90 minutter etter tiden på øya.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En time med tidligere usett materiale, inkludert dramatiske øyeblikk fra bålseremoniene, avsløringer fra deltakerne og mye mer.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: ire nye par tar en reise til Temptation Island for å se om forholdet deres tåler alt.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Singlene flytter inn, og det går vilt for seg. Det første «bålet» byr på smertefulle oppvåkninger.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Noen par begynner å nyte sin nyvunnede uavhengighet, mens andre forblir fast i fortiden.
